headline: Luxury stocks split as investors weigh China recovery against Europe tourism
body:
European luxury shares ended mixed on Wednesday. Groups with high exposure to outerwear and travel retail rose after upbeat comments on October trading in Europe, where an early cold spell and strong Chinese tourist flows lifted sales, while leather-goods names fell after Maison Arlenne's quarterly miss.

China's consumer confidence index edged up in September but remains near historic lows. Investors are watching the Double 11 shopping festival, which kicked off on Tuesday, for clues on high-end spending.
